baseline_models.mechanism: Comparison-sayings are actively rendered before the human audience; aql supplies discrimination and restraint from ignorance, while ilm supplies disclosure, so public availability and successful uptake are distinct.

activation_trace.role: The struck-parable image supplies the formulated comparison being presented.
Depicting and making a parable manifest makes the presentation active rather than incidental.
The human-community image marks a universal public audience and separates exposure from uptake.
Intellect as a restraint from ignorance supplies discriminating, corrective comprehension.
Disclosure to the knower defines the recipient in whom comprehension succeeds.

changed_reading.before: Parables are told, and scholars understand them.
changed_reading.after: Comparison-forms are actively made manifest for all people, but only disclosed and disciplined understanding completes their uptake.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: الأمثال as model-images, نضربها as casting a form, and يعقلها as binding
baseline_models.mechanism: A parable can operate as a reproducible model-form. Aql halters the mobile surface image to its marked referent, and ilm supplies the landmark by which the mapping is kept from drifting.

activation_trace.role: The pictured model supplies a representation patterned on another thing.
The type or formula image supplies a stable form into which the comparison is cast.
Haltering a camel supplies the binding operation that keeps image and referent connected.
A distinguishing landmark supplies the sign against which the model is oriented.

changed_reading.before: Understanding is extracting a lesson from figurative language.
changed_reading.after: Understanding is tethering a cast model to its marked referent so that the relation remains stable and usable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The punitive and impact branches latent in الأمثال نضربها, completed by restraint and marking
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus roots also permit a corrective exemplar: an impact makes a case into a warning-mark, and aql is the restraint produced when that mark is recognized.

activation_trace.role: Punitive exemplarity supplies a case made visible so others are deterred.
One thing striking another supplies the corrective impact that leaves an effect.
Restraint from ignorance turns the warning effect into inhibited misconduct.
A distinguishing mark makes the corrective case recognizable beyond itself.

changed_reading.before: The verse concerns neutral explanatory comparisons.
changed_reading.after: At the focus-only edge, the examples can also be corrective exemplars: impacts made legible as marks so that understanding restrains.

context_deltas.mechanism: Across the surah, speech, insight, and a correct answer repeatedly fail unless their relation is held through assay, attractive diversion, and changing conditions. The knowers of 29:43 are therefore tested integrators, not merely possessors of information.

activation_trace.role: The presented comparison supplies the relation whose uptake must be tested.
Haltering supplies durable binding rather than momentary recognition.
Disclosure names the successful condition that the context repeatedly tests.
Spoken belief supplies the verbal claim that exposure alone cannot validate.
Assaying metal or a person supplies trial as a disclosure mechanism.
Repeated disclosure distinguishes identities through the assay.
Fulfillment in action makes truthfulness more than a spoken label.
Making deeds appear beautiful supplies an attractive surface distortion.
Turning and blocking supplies failure to follow a path that remains visible.
Heart-sight supplies the negative control: discernment can coexist with diversion.
The correct spoken answer supplies propositional recognition without integration.
Turning something from its direction supplies the failure to carry recognition forward.
Haltering names the missing binding operation immediately after another correct answer.
Exclusive purity from association supplies crisis recognition at its clearest.
Renewed association on land exposes the failure to retain that recognition across conditions.

structural_cues: 29:2-3 opposes saying belief to assay and repeated knowledge of enacted truthfulness.
29:38 grants insight while describing beautification and path-blocking; 29:61-65 juxtaposes correct speech, absent aql, crisis purity, and renewed association.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, correct speech, insight, diversion, explicit absent aql, and situational reversal; I infer that aql is the arrow that holds disclosure stable into conduct. A live alternative is that these passages test belief generally without defining parable-comprehension specifically.

changed_reading.after: The knowers are those who hold a disclosed relation stable across testing, attractive misdirection, and situational reversal; correct words or sharp sight alone do not amount to aql.

context_deltas.mechanism: A left effect from the destroyed settlement is called a visible sign for people who use aql. This makes the focus parables readable as material-historical residues whose visible form must be tied to the narrated cause.

activation_trace.role: A parable as lesson and sign supplies the category that can include a warning-remnant.
Making the example manifest supplies presentation through a visible historical effect.
Binding supplies the cognitive tie between surviving trace and narrated cause.
The landmark image makes knowledge responsive to a materially distinguishing sign.
Leaving an effect behind supplies the durable material remainder.
A visible mark supplies the remainder's sign-function.
Appearance and disclosure make the sign publicly inspectable.
Haltering supplies the same binding response later required for the parables.

structural_cues: 29:35 places a left, clear sign and a people who use aql in one construction; 29:43 repeats aql with the parables.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a surviving effect, visible sign, and aql; I infer that the residue functions as an enacted parable by binding place to moral history. Alternatively, 29:35 may be an adjacent instance of sign-reading rather than one referent of those parables.

changed_reading.before: The parables are verbal figures heard in discourse.
changed_reading.after: The parables can include history's surviving marks: visible remains become intelligible only when reason binds them to the pattern that produced them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence takes each community by its dhanb and then differentiates the modes of collapse. Read through punitive exemplarity, the parables become a comparative failure atlas in which conduct has a trailing consequence that aql must map rather than flatten.

activation_trace.role: Punitive exemplarity supplies cases whose outcomes warn observers.
Impact supplies the concrete event by which each pattern becomes legible.
Binding supplies the cross-case mapping from conduct to outcome.
Distinguishing marks preserve differences among the cases.
Being taken to account for wrongdoing supplies the judgment link.
The tail or end of a thing supplies the exploratory image of consequence trailing conduct.
Pelting with stones supplies one differentiated failure mode.
The terrifying cry supplies a second differentiated failure mode.
The earth sinking supplies a third differentiated failure mode.
Drowning in water supplies a fourth differentiated failure mode.

structural_cues: 29:40 repeats the partition فمنهم while changing the mode of seizure and closes by assigning self-wronging.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies taking by dhanb and four differentiated outcomes; I infer a patterned conduct-to-consequence map and use the tail branch to make its direction explicit. The live alternative is that the enumeration stresses comprehensive justice without assigning a tailored correspondence to each offense.

changed_reading.before: A parable illustrates one abstract moral point.
changed_reading.after: The parables form a comparative failure atlas: conduct-patterns carry legible tails into distinct collapses, and understanding preserves rather than erases those causal differences.

context_deltas.mechanism: The spider comparison aligns a claimed guardian relation with a woven dwelling and then tests whether it performs the sheltering function. Parable-comprehension becomes structural literacy: map roles, then test load-bearing adequacy rather than stopping at visible resemblance.

activation_trace.role: Similarity supplies the relation whose functional depth must be assessed.
Depicting the comparison makes its structure available for testing.
Discriminating restraint supplies judgment about functional adequacy.
Disclosure supplies recognition of the relation beneath its surface.
Repeated similarity explicitly instantiates the focus plural of parables.
Supportive alliance supplies the protective function claimed of the chosen guardians.
The weaving creature supplies the builder and the visible network.
Shelter and dwelling supply the function against which the network is tested.
Weakness of force supplies the failure under the claimed protective function.
The knowledge closure links this exact comparison to the focus category of knowers.

structural_cues: 29:41 repeats مثل, ends with لو كانوا يعلمون, and 29:43 answers with وتلك الأمثال and إلا العالمون.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guardianship, a weaving creature, dwelling, weakness, and knowledge; I infer that shared function, not visual similarity, is the comparison's decisive arrow. Alternatively, weakness may be a general verdict without the stress-test framing.

changed_reading.before: The spider parable says that false protectors are weak.
changed_reading.after: To understand the parable is to align roles and test whether a support-system bears its claimed function; an intricate visible network can still fail as shelter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate move from parables to creation in truth supplies a calibration rule. A parable is a measured model whose correspondence should fit reality and remain answerable to visible signs, not an invitation to arbitrary resemblance.

activation_trace.role: The pictured model supplies a representation whose fit can be evaluated.
Type and formula supply the model's stable comparative form.
Binding keeps the model attached to the reality it represents.
A distinguishing landmark supplies the model's external check.
Measuring and proportioning supplies calibration rather than free association.
Stable correspondence to reality supplies the criterion of valid fit.
A visible mark supplies an inspectable reality-check for the model.

structural_cues: The ayah immediately after 29:43 shifts from parables to the measured created order and closes by naming it a sign.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies modeling, form, measuring, reality-correspondence, and a visible sign; I infer that creation calibrates the parable's mapping. Alternatively, 29:44 may simply add another sign without prescribing a method for reading parables.

changed_reading.before: A parable persuades whenever a resemblance feels suggestive.
changed_reading.after: A valid parable is a calibrated model: its relation is measured against reality and checked by distinguishing signs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The positive form of binding appears as restraint and internalization: clear signs reside in the chests of those given knowledge, and practiced revelation restrains wrongdoing. The knowers are people in whom signs become an action-governing source.

activation_trace.role: A parable as lesson and sign supplies content capable of being internalized.
Intellect as restraint from ignorance supplies the behavioral effect of comprehension.
Disclosure supplies the knowledge borne by the successful readers.
Reason that restrains from ugliness supplies an explicit behavioral analogue to aql.
Visible marks supply the signs that are carried rather than merely observed.
The source from which acts issue makes the chest an operational location, not passive storage.
Those given disclosure are identified as the bearers of the clear signs.

structural_cues: 29:45 says practiced revelation restrains, while 29:49 locates clear signs in the chests of those given knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restraint, signs in chests, and given knowledge; I infer that internalized signs become the source of inhibited and redirected action. A live alternative is that 29:45 and 29:49 describe practice and revelation separately rather than defining يعقلها.

changed_reading.before: The knowers are an intellectual class able to explain parables.
changed_reading.after: The knowers bear signs until those signs issue as restraint and practice; comprehension is embodied retention, not explanatory fluency alone.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads a theological parable as a social-infrastructure model and activates the sociability and tether branches. It remains anchored in للناس and يعقلها, the explicit affection-to-repudiation sequence, and the woven weak house. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory account of how false allegiance gains social cohesion, not as the lexical definition of المثل.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: للناس as sociable humans, الأمثال as models, and يعقلها as tethering

activation_trace.role: The pictured model supplies a representation of a social attachment-system.
Sociability that removes estrangement supplies the human need exploited by the false bond.
Tethering supplies the distinction between felt cohesion and a bond that actually holds.
Affection supplies the immediate social cohesion generated around the objects of allegiance.
A connection standing between parties supplies the relational network.
Repudiation and disavowal supply the later failure of that network.
Expulsion in anger converts former closeness into active separation.
Supportive alliance supplies the social promise made by the chosen guardians.
The weaving creature supplies a network that is visibly connected.
Shelter supplies the durable social function the network claims.
Weakness supplies the gap between emotional cohesion and reliable protection.

changed_reading.before: The parable exposes the abstract falsity of outside protectors.
changed_reading.after: The parable can also expose attachment architecture: false objects manufacture warmth and connection, but the social web reverses into repudiation because cohesion was never load-bearing shelter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines peripheral legal and fiscal branches of aql and daraba with the earlier burden-transfer dispute. It remains anchored in three focus roots and in exact surety and burden language. Downstream prose should qualify it as a cross-domain liability model, not translate نضرب or يعقل directly as taxation or blood-money here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Punitive example in الأمثال, imposed liability in نضرب, and legal compensation in يعقلها

activation_trace.role: Punitive exemplarity supplies a case from which liability can be learned.
An imposed levy supplies the exploratory image of liability being assigned.
Legally apportioned compensation supplies a framework for tracing who answers for a wrong.
Surety and guarantee supply the false offer to assume another's liability.
Bearing an entrusted burden supplies the actual adherence of responsibility.
Weight opposed to lightness makes multiplied responsibility materially legible.

changed_reading.before: Parables clarify moral truths by analogy.
changed_reading.after: At a contained legal edge, parables can function as liability diagrams: they expose false guarantees, show how responsibility adheres and multiplies, and train the reader to apportion consequence correctly.

strongest_changes: The knowers became tested integrators rather than information-holders: correct speech and even insight can coexist with failure to bind.
The parables expanded from verbal comparisons to material remnants and differentiated historical consequence-patterns.
The spider-house and created-sign sequence made comprehension a functional stress test calibrated to reality.
Signs in chests together with restraint made successful comprehension embodied and action-governing.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet supplied repeated negative controls for knowledge, an explicit material sign addressed to people who use aql, and immediate spider and creation hinges. Together they turned a short epistemic claim into several inspectable mechanisms without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the material remnant is included within those parables or is only a nearby analogue for sign-reading.
Whether the differentiated punishments imply offense-specific causal mapping or only comprehensive justice.
Whether the social-weaving and liability models are productive branch resonances or too distant for ordinary synthesis.
